status: Exploratory reuse: earlier outcomes are known. Written before running this suite; not a blinded preregistration.
scope: 164 distance-redshift groups, 149 SPARC galaxies, 38 Milky Way rotation bins, 43 provisional vertical-force summaries, and integration of earlier electromagnetic failures

redshift.quadratic: ln(1+z)=a*(D/100Mpc)+b*(D/100Mpc)^2; positive derivative enforced throughout the observed range; diagnostic photon-history dependence, not a local field derivation
redshift.loss: Unweighted squared c*z residual on training only, matching the recovered baseline; no per-object velocity adjustments
redshift.evaluation: Split RMSE, bias, fractional log error, and descriptive 300 km/s plus distance-error sensitivity. No uncertainty-calibrated global acceptance claim.

sparc.split: Preserve original 89 train / 29 validation / 31 test galaxies
sparc.cuts: Quality <=2, inclination >=30 degrees, positive scale length, >=5 valid points; published gas and disk/bulge contributions with fixed M/L=0.5/0.7
sparc.scale: a_star=c^2*alpha from redshift training, SI units
sparc.loss: Equal weight per galaxy, mean squared log10 velocity residual
sparc.caveat: A is free, so a_star linkage is not an independently verified physical coupling

milky_way.baryonic_sensitivity: Pouliasis model I and II stellar components, without their dark halo; McMillan fixed HI/H2 gas profiles added. These are conditional morphology benchmarks, not halo-independent stellar mass measurements.
milky_way.transfer_test: SPARC-trained A,p applied without Milky Way retuning; extra force assigned a spherical conservative completion for vertical prediction
milky_way.capture_fits: External isotropic bath in a 100 kpc sphere; constant beta control and beta(r)=beta0/[1+(r/rs)^2] candidate. Zero capture outside. Fit only R<=15 kpc rotation bins; predict R>15 and all vertical points.
milky_way.capture_loss: Squared rotation residual divided by sqrt(mean statistical error^2+(0.03*vobs)^2); 3% is an explicit sensitivity floor, not a supplied covariance
milky_way.storage: Stationary accumulated deposits, ordinary cold-source Newtonian gravity; mass amplitude free because source-budget calculation remains deferred
milky_way.vertical: Bovy-Rix R0=8 retained, z=1.1 kpc; predictions in each published frame without remapping raw stars. Conditional diagnostic only: original potential assumptions, shared systematics and coordinate mismatch require refit.
milky_way.acceptance: Do not declare real-data reproduction solely from fit or diagonal scores; report boundary parameters, numerical errors, unsupported assumptions and failed tests

global: No dark matter or cosmic expansion source in fitted candidates. Previously failing timing/thermal/source tests remain requirements; do not pool incompatible or overlapping scores. Formula originality always labeled.
